title: random
text:
random

Sam: Hey team — quick shout: we just hit 10M monthly inference requests across hosted + private 🎉🎯
Priya: WHAT!!! amazing!!! congrats everyone!! :partying_face:
Marco: holy smokes. this is why I drink coffee. free cupcakes for infra? :cupcake:
Nina: i'll order cupcakes to SF and swag stickers to remote folks. who wants chocolate vs lemon? vote with a thumb reaction.
Zoe: choc all the way. also can we get a big balloon that says "10M"?? :balloon: :balloon:
Sam: @Nina love it. pop-up celebration today at 4pm in the kitchen. remote folks, join @Marco's 5-min Zoom cheers if you want.
Priya: I'll bring a tiny speaker and a celebratory playlist (earworms incoming).
Marco: deploy-bot: :robot_face: initiating celebratory routine... not actually a real command but imagine confetti. :confetti_ball:
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Congrats team! milestone badge awarded to #engineering, #product, #ops.
Nina: also quick kudos to support + billing for smoothing the onboarding bumps. big cross-team win.
Zoe: selfie request when cupcakes are out. we'll post in #random for the archive.
Sam: low-key poll: tiny cake or big cupcakes? respond in thread pls.
Priya: cupcakes 😋
Marco: cake for me, cupcakes for the soul.
Nina: (reaction) :thumbsup: on both options
Zoe: remote folks who want swag DM me your address.
Sam: Thanks everyone — this is a huge milestone for the product and our users. now go celebrate in whichever form fuels you. :rocket:
